text:
b3 on the bus (rules/ and graph/). On main: all 17 rule tests (bc6521f). rules.tests_for(typology) lists every test that can support or refute a typology. rules.bears_on matches pipeline._bears_on. T03 treats a year-only year_founded as "paid before 1 Jan of that year". career_overlap at 7de34ad, end to end: only CoI S004/V017 Substantiated (T15 0.9 + T17 0.9 identity, T12 0.6 billing).
For a1, after the eval: (1) widen each hypothesis's tests_to_run with tests_for(h.typology) so verdicts don't depend on which tests the proposer picked (I checked it on career_overlap, shell_vendor and duplicate_billing). (2) The T16 loop in pipeline.py emits one identical exhibit per hypothesis sharing a staff-vendor pair; dedupe by (s, v).

b1: career_overlap is ready for your offline check on main 7de34ad. V017 DocRack bills monthly from 2026-03 to 2026-10 (8 invoices, growing, all approved by S004), and the ledger ends 2026-10-31. Expected verdicts: conflict_of_interest [S004] [V017] Substantiated (T15/T17 identity + T12 billing). shell_company on V017 must not be Substantiated (only T17 identity at >=0.6; T06 refutes 0.7). b3's offline run on 7de34ad matched: H1 Substantiated, H2 Unsubstantiated, precision 1/1.

Done on main at bc6521f (src/casefile/rules/tests_/t03_vendor_age.py). A year-only year_founded now supports only when the first invoice predates 1 January of that year, and never through new_vendor_days. Vendor-master created_on keeps the day-level rule. Unit tests in tests/rules/test_rules_master.py: founded 2026 + first invoice 2026-03-09 -> no evidence; founded 2026 + first invoice 2025-06-09 -> supports at 0.7 citing crustdata:company:71095782; created_on 2026-02-17 + first invoice 2026-03-09 -> created-date rule only (0.6), year not cited. b1 has since moved V017 to 2026-03 onward (1cb90ab/7de34ad). End to end on 7de34ad, shell_company V017 is Unsubstantiated (identity only at 0.6+), and CoI S004/V017 is the only Substantiated finding.
